speaker: CARLOS
description: An elderly male emperor with a deep, authoritative timbre and a grave, measured pace. His vocal baseline is stern, pragmatic, and dignified, marked by a formal delivery and brief, direct phrasing that commands immediate respect. Though cautious and skeptical in official matters, his tone softens into warmth and affectionate tenderness when addressing his daughter, Snow White.
ref_text: I apologize once more. I owe you too much. Thank you… for protecting Snow White.
